memo:
THIS TURN: Play Island. Pass with Brainstorm up (1 mana). At P3's end step, just before our turn 2, cast Brainstorm to dig for Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity or Fellwar Stone. Put back surplus cards, but keep Mountain and two Islands in hand so we hit every land drop through turn 4. Lightning Bolt needs red, which we lack this turn.

TARGET: Turn 2: Mountain, then Harmonic Prodigy or a 2-mana rock. With Sol Ring, cast Sol Ring (Island) and then Harmonic Prodigy (Sol Ring plus Mountain). Vivi can't come down on turn 2, because it needs both U and R. Turn 3: Vivi Ornitier. Turn 4: Guttersnipe plus cheap spells. Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, and Counterspell or Arcane Denial.

WIN PATH: Prodigy doubles Vivi (a Wizard) and Guttersnipe (a Shaman). That is 2 pings per opponent per noncreature spell, plus 4 per instant or sorcery. Chain cheap spells, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Close around turns 7-9. P2 can combo on turns 5-7.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3. P2: sacrifice-drain combo and fastest; kill Sephiroth before four deaths in a turn. P1: an Army grows off each of our spells, with wipes and theft; cast fewer, bigger spells and burn it second. P3: slow control; leave it alone early.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (3/3), Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters. It can't kill Pitiless Plunderer (1/4) or Kambal (2/4). Don't chump-block into P2's drains.

HOLD: Keep Lightning Bolt until a real target appears; no early face Bolts.

REPLAN IF: Brainstorm finds a rock (adjust the turn-2 line). P2 lands Sephiroth or a sacrifice outlet early. An opponent has a fast-mana start.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain. Cast Harmonic Prodigy using Island plus Mountain. That uses all our mana; nothing yet is worth holding Lightning Bolt up for. Keep Ponder for turn 4, when it grows Vivi Ornitier. Our hand is 6 after this, so no discard.

TARGET: Turn 3: play Island, then cast Vivi Ornitier with all 3 lands. Turn 4: play Island, then cast Ponder with 1 land. Ponder gives Vivi 2 counters and pings each opponent 2 via Harmonic Prodigy. Tap Vivi for 2, which with 3 lands gives 5 mana. Cast Guttersnipe (3), leaving 2 up for Cyclonic Rift, or Lightning Bolt using the Mountain or Vivi's R. Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, and Sol Ring or signets. Ponder digs for these.

WIN PATH: Harmonic Prodigy doubles the triggers of Vivi Ornitier and Guttersnipe. Each instant or sorcery then deals 2 (Vivi) plus 4 (Guttersnipe) to each opponent, and Vivi gets 2 counters. Chain cheap spells, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot around turns 7-9. P2's loop is the fastest clock (turns 5-7).

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3. P2: sacrifice-drain combo and fastest; kill Sephiroth before four deaths in a turn. P1: Army grows off our spells once Sauron is out; cast fewer, bigger spells then and hit P1 second. P3: slow control; leave it alone and expect spot removal on Vivi.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER, Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters. It can't kill Pitiless Plunderer (1/4). Single-target Cyclonic Rift (2 mana) is for Grave Pact, Ashnod's Altar or The One Ring. Never target Sauron with it: targeting triggers ward, so we would have to sacrifice Vivi. Only the overloaded Rift (7 mana) removes Sauron. Cast it at the end step of the opponent just before our turn, or on the turn we win. Don't chump-block into P2's drains.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt and Cyclonic Rift for the targets above. No face burn.

REPLAN IF:
- A rock is drawn: cast it with Vivi and hold up interaction.
- Harmonic Prodigy dies: Vivi Ornitier still comes down on turn 3.
- P2 lands Sephiroth together with a sacrifice outlet: on turn 3, cast Lightning Bolt on Sephiroth before Vivi.
- Someone casts Toxic Deluge or Blasphemous Act.

THIS TURN: Play Island. Cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, no tax yet) using Island, Island and Mountain. That taps us out, which is acceptable because no opponent has a creature. Do not cast Ponder this turn: it would leave no mana for Vivi. If we draw Sol Ring, cast Sol Ring with the new Island first, then cast Vivi with Island, Mountain and Sol Ring.

TARGET: Next turn, play Island (4 lands) and cast Ponder with one Island. Harmonic Prodigy doubles Vivi's trigger, so Vivi gets 2 counters and pings each opponent for 2. Tap Vivi for {R}{R}, then cast Guttersnipe with {R}{R} plus one Island. Keep Island and Mountain untapped for Cyclonic Rift or Lightning Bolt. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, and rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet).

WIN PATH: With Harmonic Prodigy out, each instant or sorcery deals 2 from Vivi and 4 from Guttersnipe to each opponent. Chain cantrips, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot around turns 7-9. P2's loop (turns 5-7) is the fastest clock. Nobody can kill us before our next turn.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3. P2: sacrifice-drain combo, 7 cards in hand, the only player with open mana; Lightning Bolt goes on Sephiroth. P1: Sauron's Army grows off our spells; hit P1 second and cast fewer, bigger spells once Sauron lands. P3: slow control; leave it alone and expect Swords to Plowshares or Snuff Out on Vivi (she is not black).

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER, Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters. Single-target Cyclonic Rift for Grave Pact, Ashnod's Altar or The One Ring. Never target Sauron (ward: sacrifice a legendary); only overloaded Cyclonic Rift ({6}{U}) handles him. Don't chump-block into P2's drains.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt and Cyclonic Rift for the targets above. No face burn.

REPLAN IF: Vivi Ornitier is countered or killed (recast costs 5). Sephiroth lands next to a sacrifice outlet: cast Lightning Bolt on it next turn before anything else. We draw Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots: cast and equip them to Vivi before Guttersnipe. A wipe resolves.

THIS TURN: Play Sulfur Falls (it enters untapped because we control an Island). Cast Ponder with one Island. Harmonic Prodigy doubles Vivi Ornitier's trigger, so Vivi reaches power 2 and pings each opponent for 2. Activate Vivi for {R}{R}, then cast Guttersnipe with {R}{R} plus Mountain. Keep the other Island and Sulfur Falls open. If we draw Sol Ring, cast it first (1 land) so Vivi grows before Ponder, and use its {C}{C} toward Guttersnipe. If we draw Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, cast and equip them to Vivi before activating her, then cast Guttersnipe.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier, Harmonic Prodigy and Guttersnipe online. Guttersnipe is a Shaman, so it triggers twice. Each instant or sorcery then deals 6 to each opponent: 4 from Guttersnipe and 2 from Vivi. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Sol Ring, and Crackle with Power or Jeska's Will.

WIN PATH: Chain Ponder, Lightning Bolt, Pongify and cantrips at 6 per opponent each. Grow Vivi, tap her for Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. That is about 3-4 turns, before P2's loop. Nobody can kill us before our next turn (everyone is at 39-40, with small boards).

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: Ayara drains now, and a Sephiroth sacrifice-drain combo is next. Remove its outlets.
- P3: Y'shtola is on board, with control inevitability. Pongify Y'shtola.
- P1: no board yet, but 2 open mana (Arcane Denial). Leave P1 alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lightning Bolt: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER, Blood Artist or Zulaport Cutthroat.
- Pongify: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed (Bolt can't kill a 2/4), Kambal or Emet-Selch.
- Single-target Cyclonic Rift: Grave Pact, Ashnod's Altar or The One Ring.
- Never target Sauron (ward).
- Once Sephiroth is out, don't kill creatures unless the kill is Sephiroth.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt, Pongify, Cyclonic Rift, plus the Island and Sulfur Falls, for opponents' turns. Each instant still triggers Guttersnipe and Vivi's ping. At the end of P3's turn, if Pongify is unused, Pongify Y'shtola. Keep the Island in hand as next turn's land.

REPLAN IF: Guttersnipe or Vivi Ornitier is countered or killed. Sephiroth lands. Sauron lands (cast fewer spells). A wipe resolves.

THIS TURN: Play Island and keep Temple of Epiphany for next turn. Cast Vivi Ornitier for all 5 lands ({1}{U}{R} plus tax 2). P1 and P2 are tapped out. P3 has only Drowned Catacomb open: that could pay for Swords to Plowshares, and Snuff Out is free because Vivi is not black. We accept that risk. After this we are tapped out, so there are no instant plays on opponents' turns.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier alive next to Harmonic Prodigy and Guttersnipe. Prodigy doubles both of their triggers, so each instant or sorcery deals 6 to each opponent (Guttersnipe 4, Vivi 2) and gives Vivi +2 power. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will, Grapeshot.

WIN PATH: Next turn, play Temple of Epiphany (it enters tapped), which leaves 5 usable lands.
- Pongify Y'shtola, Night's Blessed ({U}). Vivi goes to power 2.
- Lightning Bolt P1's face ({R}). Vivi goes to power 4.
- Activate Vivi for 4, add the 3 remaining lands, and overload Cyclonic Rift ({6}{U}).
- That is 18 to each opponent, plus 3 more to P1. Life totals become about P1 7, P2 17, P3 16.
- Finish the turn after with Grapeshot or Crackle with Power, or any chain of spells.
- Our clock is 2-3 turns, faster than every opponent's.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2.
- P3: Y'shtola, heavy removal and drains, and P3 has already killed Vivi twice. Pongify Y'shtola.
- P1: 4 lands plus Talisman, so Sauron can land next turn with a land drop and punish every spell. Overloaded Cyclonic Rift answers Sauron without targeting him.
- P2: Braids drains and P2 holds 7 cards, but Sephiroth is not on the battlefield. Leave P2 alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Pongify: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.
- Lightning Bolt: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER if it lands. Otherwise P1's face.
- Overloaded Cyclonic Rift: Sauron, the Dark Lord or a wide board.
- Never target Sauron; his ward demands a legendary sacrifice.
- Once Sephiroth is out, kill no creatures except Sephiroth.
- For Braids' end-step sacrifice, offer Guttersnipe before Vivi, and Harmonic Prodigy last. Taking 2 life instead is fine.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt, Pongify and Cyclonic Rift for next turn's chain. Temple of Epiphany is next turn's land.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi Ornitier is removed: cast the instants at opponents' end steps for Guttersnipe damage (4 each per instant).
- Sauron or Sephiroth lands.
- A wipe resolves.
- We draw Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots.

THIS TURN:
- Braids' trigger on the stack: decline to sacrifice and lose 2 life (we are at 28). Keep Vivi Ornitier and Harmonic Prodigy.
- We are tapped out until our untap, so we make no plays on P3's turn.
- Our turn: play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1).
- Lightning Bolt Braids, Arisen Nightmare with Mountain. Prodigy doubles Vivi's trigger: +2 counters and 2 damage to each opponent.
- Hold Pongify, Negate and Cyclonic Rift with 4 open lands. Only if we draw a spell worth casting, activate Vivi for her power first and spend that mana.

TARGET:
- Vivi Ornitier protected next to Harmonic Prodigy, which doubles her triggers (2 damage each and +2 power per noncreature spell).
- Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Guttersnipe replacements (Veyran, Voice of Duality, Coruscation Mage), and finishers (Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will, Grapeshot).

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi through chains of spells, then spend her mana on a big X spell or an overloaded Cyclonic Rift. The clock is about 4 turns and slower without Guttersnipe. Opponents are at 28, 35 and 32.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P2 > P1.
- P3: has killed Vivi twice, holds 7 cards and removal, and Y'shtola returns. Pongify Y'shtola, Night's Blessed when it lands.
- P2: Braids, 7 cards and repeated edicts; Sephiroth is coming. Bolt Braids now.
- P1: tapped out with a small board. Leave them alone; overloaded Cyclonic Rift answers Sauron later.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lightning Bolt: Braids, Arisen Nightmare.
- Pongify: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed, or Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER.
- Negate: removal or a wipe aimed at Vivi (Anguished Unmaking, Toxic Deluge, Feed the Swarm).
- Never target Sauron (his ward demands a legendary sacrifice).
- Once Sephiroth is out, kill only Sephiroth.
- For edicts, sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy before Vivi.

HOLD: Keep Negate mana ({1}{U}) open on every opponent's turn. Keep Cyclonic Rift for Sauron or a wide board.

REPLAN IF: Vivi Ornitier dies, Sephiroth or Sauron lands, or we draw Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots or a damage payoff.

THIS TURN:
1. Play Island; it enters untapped. Keep Temple of Epiphany for next turn.
2. Cast Lightning Bolt on Papalymo Totolymo, using Mountain. Teferi, Time Raveler allows this, since it is our main phase with an empty stack. Harmonic Prodigy doubles Vivi Ornitier's trigger: Vivi becomes 2/5 and each opponent takes 2 (P1 24, P2 33, P3 29). Prodigy becomes 2/4.
3. Attack Teferi, Time Raveler with Vivi Ornitier and Harmonic Prodigy (4 damage). P3's only other creature, the Bird Token, is tapped and flying, so Prodigy couldn't block it anyway.
4. Don't activate Vivi. Pass with 5 open: Island ×4 and Sulfur Falls.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier with Harmonic Prodigy, protected by Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, plus a payoff: Veyran, Voice of Duality, Coruscation Mage or Niv-Mizzet, Parun.

WIN PATH: Chain spells for 2 damage per spell to each opponent. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana. Our clock is about 4-5 turns; no opponent threatens lethal soon.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P2 > P1.
- P3: removal-heavy, has killed Vivi twice. Kill Teferi now; Pongify Y'shtola, Night's Blessed when it is recast.
- P2: 8 cards, Braids back in hand, edicts, Sephiroth coming. Hold Pongify for Sephiroth.
- P1: small board. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Pongify: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (before four deaths in a turn) or Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.
- Negate: removal or a wipe aimed at Vivi.
- Cyclonic Rift: overload only for Sauron, the Dark Lord (overload doesn't target, so it avoids his ward) or a wide board.
- Never target Sauron.
- Against edicts, sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy first.

HOLD: Negate ({1}{U}) and Pongify ({U}) open on every opponent's turn. While Teferi lives we can't cast them then.

REPLAN IF: Teferi survives, Vivi dies, Sephiroth, Sauron or Y'shtola lands, or we draw boots or a payoff.

THIS TURN:
1. Teferi, Time Raveler is gone, so our instants work on opponents' turns again.
2. Land drop is already used, and there is nothing worth casting now. Don't activate Vivi Ornitier.
3. Pass with 5 open: Island ×4 and Sulfur Falls. That covers Negate ({1}{U}), Pongify ({U}) and a single-target Cyclonic Rift ({1}{U}), exactly 5.
4. On opponents' turns:
   - Negate any removal spell aimed at Vivi (Swords to Plowshares, Anguished Unmaking, Void Rend, Feed the Swarm, Toxic Deluge).
   - Pongify Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Y'shtola, Night's Blessed right after it resolves.
5. Next turn, play Temple of Epiphany.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier and Harmonic Prodigy, protected by Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, plus one payoff: Veyran, Voice of Duality, Coruscation Mage or Niv-Mizzet, Parun. We also want another rock, such as Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Each noncreature spell grows Vivi and deals 2 to each opponent. When Vivi reaches power 5 or more, finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with her mana. That is about 4-5 turns. No opponent can kill us before our next turn.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P2 > P1.
- P3: heavy removal, 6 cards, Y'shtola, Night's Blessed recastable. Pongify Y'shtola when she lands.
- P2: 8 cards, Braids, Arisen Nightmare in hand, Sephiroth coming. Pongify Sephiroth before four deaths in a turn.
- P1: only a 1/1 Army. Leave them alone and don't feed the Army with many small spells on their watch.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Pongify: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER first, or Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.
- Negate: removal or a wipe aimed at Vivi.
- Cyclonic Rift: overload only for Sauron, the Dark Lord or a wide board. Never target Sauron.
- Against edicts, sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy.

HOLD: all three instants and all 5 mana on opponents' turns.

REPLAN IF: Vivi dies, Sephiroth, Sauron or Y'shtola resolves, P2 goes wide, or we draw boots or a payoff.

THIS TURN:
1. Play Temple of Epiphany (it enters tapped). Scry 1: keep Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, a payoff or a rock; bottom a land.
2. In main phase 1, activate Vivi Ornitier for 2 ({U}{R}). Spend that mana on Cyclonic Rift ({1}{U}) targeting P1's Orc Army Token. The token ceases to exist, with no Ape left behind. Harmonic Prodigy doubles Vivi's trigger, so Vivi becomes 4/7 and each opponent takes 2.
3. Don't attack. Vivi stays home to block Braids, Arisen Nightmare.
4. Pass with all 6 untapped lands open (Island ×4, Mountain, Sulfur Falls).
   - Negate ({1}{U}): removal aimed at Vivi (Swords to Plowshares, Snuff Out, Void Rend, Feed the Swarm), a wipe, or Exsanguinate.
   - Pongify ({U}): Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER right after it resolves, otherwise Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.

TARGET: Vivi and Harmonic Prodigy under Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, plus Veyran, Voice of Duality, Coruscation Mage or Niv-Mizzet, Parun. Add Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Every noncreature spell deals 2 to each opponent and grows Vivi by 2. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, in about 4 turns. Nobody can kill us before our next turn.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3.
- P2: 7 cards, Cabal Coffers and Nykthos mana, Sephiroth coming. Pongify Sephiroth before four deaths in a turn.
- P1: can cast Sauron, the Dark Lord next turn. Remove the Army now and don't feed them spells.
- P3: slow control. Negate their removal and otherwise leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Pongify: Sephiroth first, then Y'shtola. Never target Sauron. His ward counters the spell unless we sacrifice a legendary creature, and Vivi is our only one.
- Blasphemous Act (if drawn) also kills Vivi, so cast it only in an emergency.
- Edict: sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy.
- Braids trigger: take the 2 life loss while we are at 10 or more life. Never sacrifice Vivi.

HOLD: Negate, Pongify and all 6 lands during opponents' turns.

REPLAN IF: Cyclonic Rift is countered, Sauron resolves, Vivi dies, Sephiroth or Y'shtola lands, or we draw boots or a payoff.

reason: executor escalation: P3: life 24→16 (-8); we lost: Vivi Ornitier; our commander left the battlefield
memo:
THIS TURN:
1. Now, on P2's Braids, Arisen Nightmare end-step trigger, take the 2 life loss (19→17). Do not sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy or anything else.
2. During P3's turn we have 0 mana, so pass.
3. On our turn, play any land drawn. Then cast Vivi Ornitier from the command zone for {1}{U}{R}+4, which is 7 mana and taps all 7 lands (8 if a land was drawn).
4. Equip Lightning Greaves to Vivi immediately ({0}) to give her shroud and haste.
5. If an 8th land came, keep {U} up for Pongify.
6. Don't attack. Casting Vivi gives P1's Sauron one amass; accept it.

TARGET: Vivi under Lightning Greaves, Harmonic Prodigy beside her, plus Veyran, Voice of Duality, Coruscation Mage or Stormcatch Mentor, and Sol Ring or Arcane Signet. Keep Negate up behind that board.

WIN PATH: Rebuild Vivi. Chain cheap spells (2 pings each with Harmonic Prodigy), then Crackle with Power or Jeska's Will off Vivi's mana. That is about 3-4 turns out. P1 is the fastest clock at 7+ power a turn.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P3.
- P1: Sauron 7/6 plus a growing Army, 13 life, and every spell we cast grows it. Don't feed them cheap spells; block the Army.
- P2: Braids drains 2 each turn and Sephiroth is coming. Pongify Sephiroth.
- P3: slow control. Leave them alone and Negate their removal or Exsanguinate.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sauron: never target him, because his ward needs a legendary sacrifice. Chump him only if lethal.
- Orc Army attacks: block it with Harmonic Prodigy (1/3) to stop the Ring tempt and wheel.
- Sephiroth: Pongify.
- Edicts: sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy, never Vivi.
- Braids triggers: pay life while we are at 8 or more.

HOLD: Negate for a wipe or Exsanguinate once mana allows. Pongify for Sephiroth.

REPLAN IF: we draw Blasphemous Act or a mana rock, Vivi is countered, Sephiroth lands, or P1 attacks us below 8 life.

THIS TURN:
1. Opponents are effectively tapped out. P3's only untapped land is Skycloud Expanse, which needs other mana to use. This is the safe window for Vivi.
2. If you drew a land, play it. If you drew Sol Ring, cast it first ({1}).
3. Cast Vivi Ornitier for 7 mana ({1}{U}{R}+4). Sauron amasses once; accept it.
4. Equip Lightning Greaves to Vivi ({0}).
5. Don't attack.
6. If {U} is still open on P1's turn and the Orc Army attacks, Pongify the Army after attackers are declared. Casting it amasses first, then the Army dies and P1 gets a 3/3 Ape. Vivi deals 2 to each opponent through Harmonic Prodigy.
7. Hold any other drawn card.

TARGET: Vivi with shroud and 4+ counters, Harmonic Prodigy, Ophidian Eye on Harmonic Prodigy (Vivi has shroud), then Veyran, Voice of Duality or Coruscation Mage, plus Sol Ring.

WIN PATH: Each noncreature spell deals 2 to each opponent. P1 is at 8. Pongify plus Ophidian Eye is only 4, so killing P1 next turn needs a drawn burn spell (Grapeshot, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will) or cheap spells. Otherwise grow Vivi and tap her for mana. P1 hits for about 12 a turn and we are at 16, so we have about 2 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P3 > P2.
- P1: 11 power, and each of our spells amasses. Burn them out; that is our kill.
- P3: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat recasts from the graveyard when P3's opponents lose life (its Wizard token pings). Our pings don't trigger it. Negate key recasts.
- P2: no board, but 7 cards and Cabal Coffers. Watch for Sephiroth.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Orc Army: Pongify, or chump with Harmonic Prodigy to stop the Ring wheel.
- Sauron: never target him (ward). Block him only if the damage is lethal.
- Emet-Selch recasts, Toxic Deluge, Exsanguinate: Negate ({1}{U}).
- Edicts: sacrifice Harmonic Prodigy.

HOLD: Negate for a wipe or Exsanguinate. Never block with Vivi unless lethal.

REPLAN IF: Vivi is removed, we fall below 8 life, we draw burn (Grapeshot, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will) or Blasphemous Act, or Sephiroth or Y'shtola lands.

THIS TURN:
1. Braids, Arisen Nightmare trigger now: don't sacrifice. Take the 2 life (16→14). Any creature that dies drains us through Sephiroth.
2. Hold Pongify through P3's turn. Answer a lethal P3 threat with it if needed. Otherwise, at P3's end step, Pongify the Orc Army Token ({U} from Island). Sauron amasses first, then the Army dies and P1 gets a 3/3 Ape. This cuts P1's attack to about 10 when we have 14.
3. On our turn, play any land. Cast Vivi Ornitier for 7 ({1}{U}{R}+4). Equip Lightning Greaves to Vivi ({0}).
4. With a drawn land (8 mana), cast one cheap noncreature spell after Vivi. It deals 2 to each opponent through Harmonic Prodigy. Don't attack.

TARGET: Vivi with shroud and counters beside Harmonic Prodigy, then Sol Ring, Guttersnipe-style payoffs (Coruscation Mage, Veyran, Voice of Duality) and a finisher (Grapeshot, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will).

WIN PATH: With Vivi and Harmonic Prodigy out, each noncreature spell deals 2 to each opponent. P3 at 7 and P1 at 8 each need 4 spells, or Vivi's mana into an X spell. Aim for 2 turns. P1 still hits for about 10 a turn.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P3 > P2
- P1: 16 power plus Rogue's Passage. Kill the Army, then burn P1 first.
- P3: at 7, Emet-Selch of the Third Seat recasts its removal. Second burn target, or first if P3 is lethal-reachable.
- P2: 27 life and 9 cards, but Sephiroth isn't transformed. Don't feed it deaths; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Orc Army: Pongify. Sauron: never target him (ward). Chump him with Harmonic Prodigy only if the hit is lethal. Don't kill creatures while Sephiroth is out unless needed.

HOLD: Pongify for the Army at P3's end step.

REPLAN IF: P1 or P3 makes a bigger threat, we draw burn or Blasphemous Act, Vivi is countered or removed, or Sephiroth transforms.

THIS TURN:
1. Cast Mystic Remora ({U}, 6 mana left). Prowess makes Harmonic Prodigy 2/4. Sauron amasses, so the Orc Army Token becomes 11/11.
2. Attack P1 with Harmonic Prodigy. P1's creatures are all tapped, so it deals 2 (P1 6→4). Ophidian Eye draws a card if it is on Prodigy. P1 losing life lets P3's Emet-Selch of the Third Seat recast one instant or sorcery; Greaves keeps Prodigy safe from targeted spells. Don't cast Vivi Ornitier this turn: she takes all 7 mana and adds 0 mana at 0 power.
3. Hold Pongify ({U}). On P1's turn, after attackers are declared and after any Rogue's Passage activation, Pongify the Orc Army Token if it attacks us. Its death lets P2's Sephiroth drain someone for 1, possibly us. Take Sauron's 7 without chumping: about 14→6. If the Army attacks only P3, keep Pongify.
4. Cast any drawn instant only for lethal or a must-answer spell.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier with Lightning Greaves beside Harmonic Prodigy, so each noncreature spell deals 2 to each opponent. Missing: cheap spells (Opt, Consider, Gitaxian Probe), Sol Ring, Grapeshot, Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will.
